summary_1line: Yudhishthira accepts a second dice game staking exile; Sakuni wins immediately, sending the Pandavas into forest exile as Dussasana mocks them.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandava brothers silently remove their royal robes and don rough deer-skins in the Kuru assembly while courtiers watch in anguish.
Sakuni casts the dice before the court and calmly declares victory as Yudhishthira sits resigned, knowing the ruin it brings.
Dussasana stands laughing and taunting as the Pandavas, clad in deer-skins, prepare to leave the palace for twelve years of exile.
